name: Deep work habit
summary: Build a deep work habit with focus blocks on your calendar and optional focus-room sessions with others.

onboarding.prompt: What pulls you off track most?
Focus hours per week to aim for?
Want to join focus rooms with others?
onboarding.reaction: Noted. You can change this any time.

phases.name: Start small
benchmarks: Half the weekly focus goal reached
actions: Two to three focus blocks a week

phases.name: Build
benchmarks: Three quarters of the goal reached

phases.name: Hold
benchmarks: Weekly goal reached two weeks running

plan_blueprint.calendar: Focus blocks on the chosen slots in your best hours, optional focus-room invites, and a Friday review.

approach_variants.habit: Same block at the same time daily; streak of blocks kept.
approach_variants.time: Every block is a calendar event with a stated task; weekly time review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward each week the goal is reached.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up a quiet spot, headphones and app blockers.

guardrails: This is personal growth, kept outside any employer's tools; nothing is shared with your workplace.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
Product, app or recipe ideas are labeled as suggestions; any affiliate link is disclosed.
restart_rules: A missed block is not made up; the next one counts. A low week repeats the same target instead of raising it.
